name: Plate XII: The Chymical Wedding of Sun and Moon
description: Sol and Luna, the red king and the white queen, circling toward the conjunction from which the Mercury of the wise is born. Struck in Folio: iron-gall ink on rag paper, as the old plates were printed. Degree of Initiate, rank 331 of the folio. “V · I · T · R · I · O · L”: Visit the interior of the earth; by rectifying you will find the hidden stone.
